{{Term/Store|Cursed Moblin|Cursed Moblins|Series, BotW|plural}} are [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{BotW}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''Cursed Moblin'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
{{Compendium/Extract|Cursed Moblin}}
Cursed Moblins are the heads of [[Moblin]]s that have been resurrected by [[Malice]].<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|The Malice has given these Moblin skulls a pitiful life after death. The only fragment of their former selves they've held on to is the ferocity innate to all Moblins, so they will attack anyone that approaches. They're tougher than Bokoblin skulls. |Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> The only part of their life they retain is the ferocity of a [[Moblin]], resulting in them attacking anyone that comes close to them.<ref name="Compendium"/>

Cursed Moblins are created by [[Pool of Malice|Pools of Malice]] that have mouths. When the [[Glowing Eyeball]] attached to the Malice notices [[Link]], its mouth will begin to spit out Cursed Moblins. They tend to charge at [[Link]] after chomping their jaws. As is the case with all cursed [[Enemy|Enemies]], they will continuously spawn from Pools of Malice. Destroying their respective Glowing Eyeball will halt their spawns. They can be defeated with a single strike from any [[Weapon]]. Cursed Moblins can be found in [[Divine Beast]]s, as well as in the [[First Gatehouse]] and [[Second Gatehouse]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]].
